title: GstReturnRecordedPayload
description: Payload of the GstReturnRecorded event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

form.description: The GST return form, e.g. F5, F7, F8 (services.yaml, versioned per form).

irasFilingReference.description: IRAS filing reference. Added 26 Sep 2026 (standards review): submission-svc's filing fact needs the same evidence on every path (FR-AF.36).

acknowledgementHash.description: Hash of the filing acknowledgement. INV-REQ-653 behavior 6: "The published `GstReturnRecorded` carries the period, form, return version, `filedAt`, the acknowledgement hash and the reference where present". The published text fixes no algorithm or encoding. Optional, not in required.
